## HubSpot Company Domain Enrichment Mapper
New company → root domain → company metadata API → HubSpot industry, employee count and tech stack.

**Safe by default:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true` sends every planned write to *Dry-Run Telemetry*.

**Setup:** load `.env`, create the custom company properties, then select your own credentials on the trigger, HubSpot and enrichment nodes. Code nodes are generated by `./build.sh`; do not edit them in n8n.

nodes.name: HubSpot Company Created
nodes.notes: Requires a HubSpot developer app subscribed to company.creation.

nodes.name: Company Created Webhook
nodes.notes: Alternative entry point for a HubSpot workflow "Send a webhook" action. Send the secret in the x-webhook-secret header.

nodes.name: Normalize & Verify Events
nodes.notes: Validates config (fail fast), verifies the webhook secret, dedupes company IDs.

nodes.name: HubSpot Get Company
nodes.notes: Fetches domain, website and current enrichment fields. Errors continue as items.

nodes.name: Extract Root Domain
nodes.notes: Normalizes domain/website to a root domain and decides whether to enrich.

nodes.name: Enrichment API Lookup
nodes.notes: Company metadata API. 404 → NOT_FOUND, 429 → RATE_LIMITED, 401/403 → ERROR_AUTH, other → ERROR_PROVIDER.

nodes.name: Map Enrichment to HubSpot
nodes.notes: Maps industry, employee count and tech stack; preserves existing values unless OVERWRITE_EXISTING=true.

nodes.name: Dry-Run Telemetry
nodes.notes: Sandbox branch: logs what would be written. Nothing is sent to HubSpot.

nodes.name: HubSpot Update Company
nodes.notes: PATCH /crm/v3/objects/companies/{id}. Batched to respect HubSpot rate limits.

nodes.name: Log Update Results
nodes.notes: Live branch: sanitized success / failure log for each company.
